findings.title: Ghost CMS CVE-2026-26980 Pre-Auth SQL Injection — Mass ClickFix Campaign Compromises 700+ Domains Including Harvard / Oxford / Auburn / DuckDuckGo
findings.affected_technology: Ghost CMS (Node.js publishing platform) versions 3.24.0 through 6.19.0; patched 6.19.1 released 2026-02-19
findings.summary: XLab disclosed 2026-05-24 large-scale active exploitation of three-month-old Ghost CMS SQL injection enabling admin API key exfiltration and persistent ClickFix-payload injection across 700+ high-profile domains (Harvard, Oxford, Auburn, DuckDuckGo); at least two distinct activity clusters re-infect cleaned sites with DLL loaders / JS droppers / UtilifySetup.exe Electron malware.

findings.title: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin CVE-2026-48172 — Maximum-Severity (CVSS 10.0) cPanel-User-to-Root RCE Actively Exploited Across Shared Hosting
findings.affected_technology: LiteSpeed User-End cPanel Plugin v2.3 through v2.4.4 (LiteSpeed WHM plugin not affected); patched in 2.4.5+ and bundled into WHM plugin 5.3.1.0
findings.summary: Incorrect privilege assignment in lsws.redisAble lets any cPanel user execute arbitrary scripts as root on the host; LiteSpeed confirmed in-the-wild exploitation 2026-05-22 with single-grep IoC primitive — pairs directly with cPanel CVE-2026-41940 IAB+ransomware monetization chain on shared hosting hosts.

findings.title: Laravel-Lang PHP Packages Supply Chain Compromise — 700+ Malicious Versions Pushed via Git-Tag Rewriting Targeting Composer Autoload
findings.summary: Attackers rewrote every existing git tag in each of four Laravel-Lang repos to point to malicious commits delivering an autoload-registered src/helpers.php credential stealer (cloud creds, wallets, browser data, VPN configs, env vars on Windows/Linux/macOS); 700+ compromised versions published 2026-05-22 / 2026-05-23 within seconds of each other indicating automated mass-tag rewriting — third major mutable-package-metadata abuse in 30 days after Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 2 + Megalodon.

findings.title: Underminr DNS Domain-Fronting Variant — CDN Tenant-Misrouting Technique Affects ~88M Domains, Already Used in ClickFix Campaigns
findings.affected_technology: Shared-tenancy CDN infrastructure (US/UK/Canada-anchored CDNs most affected per ADAMnetworks)
findings.summary: ADAMnetworks disclosed 2026-05-23 a domain-fronting variant that presents the SNI and HTTP Host of a domain while forcing a request to a different tenant IP on the same shared CDN edge — defeats SNI / Host-header-based egress filtering, protective-DNS, and SWG controls; already used in ClickFix campaigns hiding C2 behind trusted CDN domains across ~88M affected scopes.

findings.title: Apache Airflow Provider Two-CVE Disclosure — CVE-2026-45361 Google ComputeEngineSSHHook Host-Key-Verification-Disabled + CVE-2026-46745 FAB Auth Manager LDAP Filter Injection
findings.summary: Two Airflow provider advisories landed on oss-security 2026-05-24: ComputeEngineSSHHook disables SSH host-key verification by default (Low, MITM-class) and FAB Auth Manager /auth/token endpoint allows unauthenticated LDAP filter injection (Moderate, CWE-90, directory exfil + auth bypass) — extends the May Airflow CVE wave (43826 / 41018 / 27173) to six cumulative provider advisories across the 2026-05-10 → 2026-05-24 window.

noted.summary: Akshat Sinha disclosed 2026-05-22; newline in .op of object tokens bypasses POSIX shell escaping in quote(); fixed in 1.8.4 via strict allowlisting of valid operator values; niche integration pattern (object-token usage) but CI/CD and build-tool exposure if attacker-controlled input reaches shell-quote.

noted.product: Apache ECharts Lines series tooltip XSS (< 6.1.0)
noted.summary: Zhongxiang Wang disclosed 2026-05-23; raw HTML in series.data[i].name rendered via innerHTML when Lines series + tooltips used without custom formatter; widely embedded charting library, risk on dashboards accepting user-controlled labels.

moritz-sauer-13/silverstripe-cms-theme + crosiersource/crosierlib-base + devdojo/wave + devdojo/genesis + katanaui/katana + elitedevsquad/sidecar-laravel + r2luna/brain + baskarcm/tzi-chat-ui compromised via package.json (not composer.json) postinstall script downloading Linux binary to /tmp/.sshd; Socket investigation found ~777 files across GitHub referencing the same payload — broader operation, no Shai-Hulud attribution.

noted.product: ROOT framework (CERN) heap buffer overflow in TKey::Streamer / TBasket::ReadBasketBuffers (CVSS 7.8)
noted.summary: Manopakorn Kooharueangrong disclosed 2026-05-24; integer overflow in fObjlen + fKeylen validation lets attacker-controlled .root files trigger 32KB heap OOB write at TBasket.cxx:601; PR #22377 fixes; relevant for CERN SWAN / batch worker / grid-storage environments processing third-party .root files.

ECDSA-NIST-curve point-addition assertion-failure DoS (MITM-triggerable pre-host-verify) + RSA-key-exchange double-free remote crash + Telnet trust-sigil persistence across proxy auth; client-side scope, but PuTTY is fleet-deployed across many enterprise admin shops — schedule upgrade in next ITSM cycle.

noted.product: PCManFM-Qt arbitrary file open via D-Bus ShowFolders
noted.summary: Aaron Rainbolt disclosed 2026-05-24; file URI passed to ShowFolders triggers MIME handler invocation rather than directory listing; with Wine+WineHQ packages installed, enables Flatpak / Snap sandbox escape by dropping an EXE and pointing PCManFM-Qt at it.

noted.product: Totolink A8000RU 6-CVE unauthenticated OS command injection batch (CVSS 9.8 each)
noted.summary: Six OS command injection CVEs across setRemoteCfg / setGameSpeedCfg / setDdnsCfg / setScheduleCfg / setLanguageCfg / setTracerouteCfg published via app.opencve.io 2026-05-24; same product family already noted 2026-04-27 (CVE-2026-7037); consumer/SOHO router IoT-botnet recruitment vector.

Colm O hEigeartaigh re-pushed 2026-05-22 thread: incomplete fix for CVE-2025-48913 JMS-untrusted-config-to-RCE + XXE in WS-Transfer + LDAP injection in XKMS LDAP Repository; same Apache-incomplete-fix pattern as MINA / OFBiz earlier in May; tracking on the list.

noted.product: Anthropic Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure dashboard launch (oss-security 2026-05-23)
noted.summary: Alan Coopersmith relayed Anthropic's new CVD tracking dashboard via oss-security; process change rather than a vulnerability, but relevant for security teams tracking Claude API surface advisories.
23-year-old Ottawa resident arrested in US/Canada for operating Kimwolf IoT botnet (30 Tbps+ record DDoS); law-enforcement action signaling continued pressure on DDoS infrastructure operators.

noted.product: CISA Contractor AWS GovCloud Credential Leak (Krebs / Schneier 2026-05-22)
noted.summary: A CISA contractor maintained a public GitHub repository containing plaintext AWS GovCloud credentials and internal CISA system details; KEV-consumer and threat-feed-consumer threat models should be re-evaluated pending CISA's incident-response disclosure.
